tips.text: Regular smallcam car is found west of Tbilisi.
Smallcam car with a long antenna on the car's right is found southwest and east of Tbilisi.
A gray truck with a mirror on the roof, a long antenna, and a visible brake light can be found in Tbilisi, usually east of the Kura River.
A blurred gray truck can be recognized by a visible long antenna and a roof mirror and can be found south and east of Tbilisi.
A blurred truck — whether it has an antenna or not — can be found along the coast, as well as along the border with Russia and the Abkhazia region.
If only back of the truck is visible, you should be between Kutaisi and Tbilisi.

An unblurred black truck is found in five clusters: Batumi, Kutaisi, Northern Tbilisi, west of Marneuli, and a few roads in the south. Each of these clusters can be further identified by the specific features.

Looking down, you can see wires running along the truck's edge. If the back-left part of the wire has black tape, you are either in the Batumi area or the Kutaisi area. Note: there are a few small roads east of Kutaisi that don't have black tape.

On some roads near the borders with Armenia and Turkey, you can see dirt on the top-right corner of the roof. Note: don't confuse this with Marneuli — both are located on roughly the same part of the roof, which makes them easy to mix up.
If the roof of your car looks like it was recently wiped down poorly, you are in Batumi area.
If the antenna is tilted towards the camera, you are in Northern Tbilisi. Note: regular tall antenna can also found in Tbilisi.
The road going west of Marneuli city, south of Tbilisi, has a unique thing that resembles a leaf on the top-right corner of the roof.
